owning_layers: Hypermesh oriented triangle-plane intersections and mesh topology

domain: Exact XY projection of finite indexed triangle faces and horizontal sections. Filled regions use signed nonzero winding across oriented closed sections, including holes, reversed, duplicated, nested and disconnected shells. Open sheets retain open section wires. Coplanar faces contribute their projected area. Isolated point contacts and zero-area projected faces are omitted by the existing regularized area/wire carrier. Invalid indices and undecided decisions must be typed failures, not empty success. External containment is not an internal resource bound.
consumers: Explicit context operations and retained outcomes
Native mesh and curve consumers where changed

semantic_oracle: Independently derived rational area, point membership, section endpoints and determinant volume; downstream extrusion and a separate manifold check. Nested and duplicate positive shells distinguish signed winding from parity. No fixture or policy weakening.
